translations.web: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a tomb.
translations.bsb: When they had carried out all that was written about Him, they took Him down from the tree and laid Him in a tomb.
translations.kjv: And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a sepulchre.
